gold_references.label: Section 86
gold_references.role: definition of cruelty for purposes of Section 85

acceptable_references.label: Section 85
acceptable_references.reason: provides punishment for cruelty by husband or relative

required_points: Section 86 defines cruelty for the purposes of Section 85 as: (a) any wilful conduct of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide or cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (mental or physical); or (b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person related to her to meet any unlawful demand for property or valuable security.
optional_points: Section 85 provides that the husband or relative of the husband who subjects a woman to such cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment up to three years and also liable to fine.
forbidden_points: Cruelty under Section 86 refers only to physical violence.
Section 86 applies to any person, not just the husband or his relatives.

notes: Direct lookup. Section 86 defines cruelty in the domestic violence context.
